proof_body:
by
  intro n P hn hP
  refine ⟨Polynomial.Chebyshev.intervalIntegrable_sqrt_one_sub_sq_inv.continuousOn_mul (by fun_prop), ?_⟩
  rw [← Polynomial.Chebyshev.integral_measureT (fun x => P.eval x), Polynomial.Chebyshev.integral_eq_sumZeroes hn hP]
  simp [Polynomial.Chebyshev.sumZeroes]
target_source: ∀ (n : ℕ) (P : Polynomial ℝ), n ≠ 0 → P.degree < 2 * n → IntervalIntegrable (fun x : ℝ => P.eval x * Real.sqrt ((1 - x ^ 2)⁻¹)) MeasureTheory.volume (-1) 1 ∧ ∫ x in (-1 : ℝ)..1, P.eval x * Real.sqrt ((1 - x ^ 2)⁻¹) = (Real.pi / n) * ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, P.eval (Real.cos ((2 * k + 1) / (2 * n) * Real.pi))
